newsitem.title: FRANCE: S&P raises LT outlook on Elf debt.
newsitem.headline: S&P raises LT outlook on Elf debt.

text.p: Standard & Poor's said on Tuesday it was revising the outlook on debt issued by Elf Aquitaine to stable from negative and affirming its ratings on the debt.

S&P said the ratings reflected "the group's position as a major integrated oil and gas company, its strong and stable cash flow generation despite difficult downstream markets, and a much strengthened financial profile."
"Strong recent improvements have brought most operating and financial measures in line with current ratings," S&P said in a statement.

"In addition to more enhanced exploration success, Standard & Poor's expects that financial measures will not deteriorate from current levels. Ratings do not factor in large share buybacks or debt-financed acquisitions," it said.
S&P said the following debt was affected by the rating:

Elf Aquitaine AA- senior unsecured debt, Elf Aquitaine A-1+ commercial paper, Elf Aquitaine UK Holding Plc AA- preferred stock, EE Finance Plc AA- senior unsecured debt, Elf Aquitaine Finance SA AA- senior unsecured debt, Elf Aquitaine Finance SA A-1+ commercial paper, Elf Petroleum UK Plc AA- senior unsecured debt, Elf Petroleum UK Plc AA- preferred stock and Elf Overseas Ltd A+ preferred stock.
